turns.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
turns.response:
With Getnet, you can advance your credit card sales (both single and installment payments) directly through the **Getnet Brasil app** (available for Android and iOS). 

There are two main ways to use receivables advance:

### 1. Spot Advance (Antecipação Pontual)
Allows you to choose when and how much to advance, with a minimum amount of R$ 50.00.
**How to do it via the app:**
1. Log in with your credentials.
2. Go to the "Serviços" (Services) menu.
3. Select "Antecipação de Vendas" (Sales Advance).
4. Choose the bank account where you want to receive the funds.
5. Read and accept the terms.
6. Simulate the advance to check the amounts, card brands, and fees, then click "Confirmar" (Confirm).
7. Review the final amount and click "Antecipar" (Advance).
8. Enter your password.
9. Track your request status under "Meus Pedidos" (My Orders).

### 2. Automatic Advance (Antecipação Automática)
Allows your future sales to be automatically advanced (requires administrative profile and password).
**How to enable it via the app:**
1. Log in with your credentials.
2. Go to the "Serviços" (Services) menu.
3. Select "Antecipação Automática" (Automatic Advance).
4. Click "Habilitar" (Enable).
5. Enter your password, read the terms and conditions, and confirm.
*Note:* The request may take up to 48 hours to be processed, and an available balance of at least R$ 50.00 is required for the advance to take place. You can also disable it at any time through the same menu.

*(Sources: Getnet Brasil, collected on 11/07/2026 - [Spot Advance Guide](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-antecipar-sua-vendas-pelo-app/) and [Automatic Advance Guide](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/))*
